dialect.detail: Uses COBOL-2002/2014 features: FUNCTION ALL INTRINSIC, ODO with DEPENDING ON, 88-level conditions on table elements, CONSTANT clause, intrinsic functions CHAR and ORD. Likely GnuCOBOL given open-source/demo nature and feature set.
evidence: pic x occurs 1 to 32768 times depending on ProgramLength

purpose.domain_detail: Esoteric programming language interpreter implemented in COBOL as a demonstration/novelty
purpose.summary: This program implements a Brainfuck esoteric language interpreter in COBOL. It reads a Brainfuck source file from the command line, loads it into memory, and executes the instructions including data pointer movement, byte increment/decrement, I/O, and bracket-based looping. It wraps data values and pointer positions at boundaries.

notable_features: ODO (OCCURS DEPENDING ON) for variable-length program storage
CONSTANT clause for named constants (DataByteUpperBound, DataByteLowerBound)
Intrinsic functions CHAR and ORD for ASCII conversion
88-level conditions on table elements used as instruction dispatch
DECLARATIVES section for file error handling
EVALUATE TRUE with 88-level conditions as dispatch table
No EXEC SQL, no EXEC CICS, no COPY statements
verdict.notes: The program is a complete, self-contained Brainfuck interpreter. The comment notes that COBOL ASCII codes start at 1 not 0, which is a GnuCOBOL/standard COBOL behavior. The CONSTANT clause is a COBOL-2002 feature. Overall a well-structured novelty/demo program, likely written for educational or entertainment purposes.
